visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a horizontal split-screen format. In the top half, a colorful animation sequence from a video game title is shown, featuring stylized characters walking through a festive forest decorated with glowing pumpkins and lanterns. In the bottom half, a woman with long black hair dressed in a brown and white maid outfit sits at a black grand piano, her hands poised over the keys. A purple cartoon cat plushie rests on the right side of the piano lid. (2) The top frame transitions through various game environments, including a sunny beach with a character encountering a pink jelly-like monster, and a group of explorers trekking through a vast snow-covered mountain range. The pianist below continues to play, her fingers moving fluidly across the ivory keys while her body sways slightly to the rhythm. The indoor setting behind her consists of neutral-toned vertical blinds. (3) The visual montage in the upper section shifts to a bustling urban square in the game, filled with NPCs and market stalls under a clear blue sky. The scene then cuts to characters running through a lush green valley toward a distant tower. The pianist's hands are shown in a medium shot, highlighting her precise technical movements and the reflection on the polished black surface of the piano. (4) The upper frame displays a series of in-game 'photographs' with white borders and heart icons, depicting various romantic and adventurous moments between the characters. The text 'Captured love' is visible on these frames. In the lower frame, the pianist completes the musical piece, resting her hands as the final notes sustain, while the purple plushie remains stationary on the instrument.
